package.description: Secure PDF Reader Program for the Drumlin Digital Rights Management (DRM) Service

en-US.description: Secure PDF Reader Program for the Drumlin Digital Rights Management (DRM) Service
en-US.longDescription:
Javelin3 and Javelin3Pro PDF Readers are free MS Windows programs that provide facilities for viewing standard PDF files, and for viewing encrypted (secure) versions of PDF files in formats (.drmz, .drmx) created for use with the Drumlin Digital Rights Management (DRM) service.
The main difference between Javelin3 and Javelin3Pro is that the Pro version includes an initial step of software registration.
en-US.name: Javelin3Pro PDF Reader

zh-CN.description: Drumlin 数字版权管理（DRM）服务的安全 PDF 阅读器程序
zh-CN.longDescription:
Javelin3 和 Javelin3Pro PDF 阅读器是免费的 Windows 平台程序，可查看标准 PDF 文件或采用 Drumlin 数字版权管理（DRM）服务生成的加密（安全）PDF 文件（支持 .drmz 和 .drmx 格式）。
Javelin3 和 Javelin3Pro 的主要区别在于 Pro 版本在启动时有软件注册步骤。
